authorize.title: Connect your ENGIE account
authorize.description:
1. [Sign in to your ENGIE account]({authorization_url}) and complete sign-in. **Keep this window open.**
2. Once finished, **copy the entire address from the browser address bar**, even if the page is blank or displays an error.
3. Return here, paste the address and select **Submit** within 10 minutes.

If your phone opens the ENGIE app, complete setup in a browser on a computer. [Need help?]({setup_url})

data_description.callback_url: Paste the full address. Do not share it.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ENGIE again
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again with the same ENGIE account used for this connection.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Open the link above, sign in again and paste the new final address.
error.cannot_connect: ENGIE is not responding. Wait a few minutes, then open the link above and sign in again.
error.storage_error: The connection could not be saved. Select Submit again without repeating sign-in.
error.invalid_callback: Copy the entire address from the browser address bar and paste it here without any other text.
error.callback_mismatch: This address comes from a different sign-in. Use the link in this window, keep it open and paste the new final address here.
error.authorization_expired: The time limit has expired. Open the new link above and sign in without closing this window.
error.authorization_used: This sign-in has already been used. Open the new link above and sign in again.
error.authorization_denied: Sign-in was not completed. Open the new link above and try again.
error.token_exchange_failed: ENGIE did not accept this sign-in. Open the new link and try again. If this happens again, report this message without sharing the address.
error.invalid_identity: Your account could not be confirmed. Sign in again using the link above. If this happens again, report this message.
error.invalid_session: The connection to ENGIE could not be completed. Sign in again using the link above. If this happens again, report this message.
error.retry_authorization: Sign-in could not be verified. Select Submit again with the same address, without repeating sign-in.

abort.wrong_account: The selected account does not match the existing integration.
